proof_scope.2205: Even vertex-splitting differential squares to zero by pairing labelled two-step expansions with opposite edge orders; odd sign proof remains cited.
proof_scope.2206: Excess-one boundaries give the three four-half-edge resolutions; source image inspected.
proof_scope.2208: Even rational theta vanishes and H(1,0)=0; integer Z/2 nonvanishing is not inferred from the sign argument.
proof_scope.220F: Degree of the configuration integral, conditional on the compactification, propagator and fiber integration constructions.
proof_scope.220H: Nonzero characteristic-class pairing detects nonzero homology, not automatically homotopy.
proof_scope.220I: Explicit beta+d(extended eta) construction; de Rham period pairing, smooth boundary extension and partition of unity are inputs.
proof_scope.220L: Parameter-space dimension only; existence of the S^(n-1) Borromean family is an external geometric input.
proof_scope.220O: Odd-dimensional forgetting-framing isomorphism for k>1 using full based fiber sequence, its long exact sequence, and rational SO(2n+1) calculation.
proof_scope.220P: Deduction of rational pi1 Diff_boundary(D4) nonzero from Theorem 3.2 and locally proved H(2,0)=Q.
proof_scope.220R: Truncation preserves homology below its top retained degree; explicit two-term counterexample at the top.
proof_scope.220T: Dimension bound for tree-length simplices from internal-vertex counts.
proof_scope.220U: L3 has 3 points; L4 has 10 vertices, valence 3 and 15 edges.
proof_scope.220V: Definition and additivity explanation of Hurewicz map, using standard homotopy invariance and sphere fundamental class.
proof_scope.2210: K4 is the only surviving graph, all vertex transpositions act evenly on edges, and no excess-one boundary survives.
proof_scope.2211: Consequence using cited sphere-diffeomorphism splitting and pi1 SO(5)=Z/2.

normalization_and_corrections: Theorem 1.1 is not imported: its odd-dimensional formula has i/j mixing; a full formula requires checking Krannich-Randal-Williams. Even-dimensional formula only applies outside its stated bands. The primary Part I text uses a different displayed band endpoint; no reconciliation is claimed.
Morlet equivalence is restricted to d != 4; no four-dimensional deduction uses it.

Self-loops are set to zero using the explicit convention in arXiv:2109.01609v3 section 2.2.1, not silently inferred from the compressed ICM definition. Parallel edges vanish in the even rational orientation quotient.

Vertex splitting uses unordered partitions of half-edges; ordered partitions require factor 1/2. Graph dual differential is defined intrinsically, avoiding an unsupported unweighted identification of unlabelled graph bases.
The propagator sphere-volume sum runs i=1,...,d with coordinates x1,...,xd; publisher HTML/PDF displays an inconsistent lower limit 0.

The full framing homotopy quotient has fiber all of Omega^d SO(d). Restricting the total space to its standard component does not on its own make the fiber Omega_0^d SO(d). Positive based homotopy comparisons use the full sequence.
Theorems 3.1 and 3.2 are detection surjections, not complete rational homotopy calculations; the former is framed and odd-dimensional, the latter unframed and even-dimensional.
Rational theta vanishing, integral theta torsion, pi0 Diff(D4), pi1 Diff(D4), and pi2 BDiff(D4) are kept separate.
Theorem 6.1 is kept at its stated sufficient dimension and excess bounds; its injectivity is attributed to report/Part II, not advertised as proved in Part I.
The finite special cycle (4,2) and its improved 2n>=34 sphere-realization bound are not promoted to a theorem about all graph classes.
Theorem 4.2 infinite-rank subgroup statement is not strengthened to an unverified assertion that the constructed subgroup is abelian.
No public page contains ul/ol catalogue lists. Outline 2200 uses nine connected narrative paragraphs.
